QUICK READ / SOUND & CONCENTRATION

Embracing privacy in the modern workplace.

Plan for the sound of the working day.

Three ideas to take into your workplace conversation.

01 / 03

Separate sources and listeners

Identify conversations, calls, equipment and movement that may disturb focused work. Start with zoning before asking a single finish or furniture item to solve every sound issue.

Next idea ↓
02 / 03

Distinguish absorption from isolation

Reducing reverberation inside a room is different from stopping sound travelling between rooms. Ask an acoustic specialist which problem needs solving and what performance is appropriate.

Next idea ↓
03 / 03

Coordinate the small gaps

Doors, glazing, ceilings and service penetrations can affect the final result. Review the assembled room and its connections rather than relying on one product rating.

Put it in your brief ↗
A PRACTICAL TAKEAWAY

Before you decide.

  • Map noisy and quiet activities.
  • Describe the required privacy in plain language.
  • Check details and performance with a specialist.
